sources.label: Multi-account and side-by-side installation patches for Stremio Android TV
sources.author: Stremio
patch_list: Addon reordering
Adds remote-friendly hold-OK reordering to Stremio's installed-addon list.
Multi-account
Adds an Android TV account chooser with isolated login, library, addons, watch state, names, colors, and PINs.
Side-by-side installation
Installs the patched app separately as Stremio Morphe instead of replacing official Stremio.

sources.label: AZK Stremio AniSkip
sources.author: AZK Stremio AniSkip
patch_list: Stremio AniSkip
Adds intro, outro and recap skip controls for anime playback in Stremio. AniSkip v1.1.1 Repository: https://github.com/AzukiSensei/aniskip-stremio

sources.label: Patches for Stremio and Vimu, for use with Morphe
sources.author: Stremio
patch_list: Auto-pick best stream
Skips the stream list and plays the top ranked stream. Enable Always show stream list to see every stream.
Avoid SDH subtitles
Prefers full dialogue subtitles over SDH/CC tracks and strips sound notes when none remain. Avoid SDH v1.0.0 Repository: https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches
Binge with external players
Auto-plays the next episode in the same external player when an episode finishes in Vimu, MX Player, VLC or mpv.
External player progress
Saves watch progress in Stremio when playing in an external player, and starts the player at the saved position.
External player progress manifest
Declares the keep-alive service for External player progress. Runs with that patch.
Hide spoilers
Hides thumbnails and synopses for unwatched episodes in Stremio. Hide spoilers v1.0.0 Repository: https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches
Intro Skip
Adds intro and recap skip controls for TV shows, movies and anime in Stremio. Intro Skip v1.0.0 Repository: https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches
Remember tracks per show
Remembers the last audio and subtitle choice for each series and applies it to other episodes.
